en: This postcard depicts a waterfront scene with a series of old buildings lining a quay, reflected in calm water. Notably, a prominent round tower, the White Tower, stands near the right side of the image. The sky is blue with fluffy clouds. The postcard includes text in both French ('Souvenir de Salonique. Tour blanche et quai de Salonique') and another script, possibly Greek or Ottoman Turkish.
